+import heapq

+def _routes(data, *, exact, minimum):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    visit = {node: 0 for node in range(data["n"])}
+    for i, node in enumerate(required):
+        visit[node] |= 1 << i
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial_mask = visit[source]
+    start = data["start"]
+    best = {(source, initial_mask, 0): start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and (not exact or used == coupons):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            durations = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < coupons:
+                durations.append((max(minimum, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in durations:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | visit[next_node]
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
